title: When the Ledger Breaks
author: Dominic Vasquez
blurb: Felix Blackwood, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, has spent seven years learning which silences keep people safe. Then a sealed letter names the family in a plot no one wants a part of — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
